title: Policy-driven region routing, retention enforcement, and automated evidence exports for Hosted API
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Deliver a policy-driven controls layer for the Hosted API that enables tenant-level region routing (soft and hard pinning), automated retention lifecycle enforcement, and a machine-readable evidence export used for audits. This ticket scopes the product requirements, rollout strategy, acceptance criteria, and initial telemetry/observability needs. The feature must work with existing model routing, support per-tenant overrides, and expose admin controls in Console and the Management API.
acceptance_criteria: Admins can create and persist per-tenant routing policies that pin traffic to a list of regions (soft and hard modes)
Retention rules (time-based and event-based) can be created per-tenant and applied automatically to stored request metadata and cached artifacts
Automated evidence exports generate an audit bundle (JSON + signed manifest) containing residency decisions, retention actions, and supporting telemetry for a selected time window
Management API endpoints follow existing versioning and role-based access control patterns and are covered by integration tests
Console UI surfaces a clear policy editor, effective policy preview (resolution order), and a time-to-compliance estimate for large tenant changes
No regressions for default routing behavior and latency SLOs remain within 5% of baseline in canary tests
notes: 2026-02-28 - Discovery: PM-led interviews with three compliance customers revealed need for both soft pinning (preference) and hard pinning (enforced) semantics. Legal wants signed evidence bundles for audits.

2026-03-01 - Architecture sync with Eng (Marco, Priya): decision to implement policy evaluation in control plane with cached decision tokens attached to requests to avoid hotpath lookups. Trade-off: additional token issuance increases overall system complexity but simplifies runtime routing latency.
2026-03-02 - Security review kickoff: Security requested threat model and KMS handling for signed manifests. Assigned ENG-8560 to implement HSM-backed signing and rotation API.

2026-03-03 - Design review: Console mockups (two variants) considered: compact inline policy editor vs. dedicated policy studio. Chosen: dedicated policy studio because it better supports complex rule previews and bulk edits.

2026-03-04 - Risk: Bulk tenant policy changes can cause large rebalancing events. Plan: rate-limit policy application and provide dry-run tools with estimated re-route volume. Blocker: need telemetry hooks outlined by ENG-7431.

2026-03-06 - Compliance feedback: added requirement that evidence bundles include canonical mapping from request -> routing decision -> final data residency location and list of retention actions applied. PM to add sample schema to PRD.

2026-03-07 - Implementation plan: Phase 1 (policy model + Management API + evidence export MVP), Phase 2 (Console studio + retention UI + canary controls), Phase 3 (analytics + SLA prompts + rollout automation). Target Phase 1 for hosted-2026.04 release.
2026-03-07 - Next steps: Create ENG tickets for policy evaluator, token issuance, evidence export worker, and Console policy studio flows. Schedule security design review for 2026-03-10.
links: Security ticket: ENG-8560 (HSM signing for evidence bundles)
